reason: Checks confirm the finding. (1) CI, in tools/coordinject_patch.py: each video's failure is caught separately, a deadline skip leaves the rest of that shard untouched, the rewrite goes to a tmp file with a line-count check before os.replace, and the outer try/except deletes the tmp so submission.csv stays as written. If CI runs without an exception but gives a wrong result, each node moves at most MAX_UM 3.0 x ALPHA 0.5 = 1.5 um, and ids and edges do not change. (2) SEC and inference: a sha miss raises FileNotFoundError, and _wait_for_prediction_shards / _merge_prediction_shards raise on any failed shard or missing geff. So any failure is a hard ERROR that shows. The SINGLE-SEED line is only a global manifest print. (3) The finding left out the timed per-dataset silent paths: ILP timeout 1200 s per dataset (SCIP keeps its incumbent), DIVINS deadline 28800 s and REPAIR deadline 34200 s. None of the new parts moves them. In the dummies, ILP times are the same with and without DIS 2.25 (exp89r 76.2 s vs exp85a 76.1 s at 76k nodes, about 15x under the limit). CI runs after the writer, so it cannot push the DIVINS or REPAIR deadlines. n2a is secondary weights of the same architecture, so the runtime is the same. Ledger: pre-CI runtime about 7.0-7.7 h, under the 8.0 h DIVINS deadline, and every safetail candidate shares these paths, #37 included. (4) The dummy counts check out: all 6 _dl logs show 0 COORDINJECT_WORKER FAILED, 0 REPAIR FAILED, 0 DIVINS FAILED/SKIPPED, 0 DEADLINE and 0 COORDINJECT FAILED, with SUMMARY 4/4 and 0.913-0.917 of nodes replaced. The hidden rerun is one run over public and private, so every candidate's private outcome is already fixed. An info-only line is the right action. Only caveat: '<= ~0.001' is CI's PUBLIC step. The real loss is CI's private gain on the affected videos, and its size and sign are unknown.
fix: Keep the action as info only. Rewrite the finals-card v5 line to: 'Silent private-only failure: CI falls back per video to the non-CI rows (loss = CI's own private gain on those videos, ~0.001 on public); SEC, K and DIS have no per-dataset failure path (a failure is an ERROR); the timed paths (ILP 1200 s per dataset, DIVINS 28800 s, REPAIR 34200 s) and the REPAIR/DIVINS fallbacks are shared by every candidate incl. #37, and SEC, K, DIS and CI do not move them (ILP time is the same with DIS 2.25; CI runs after the writer). The partner hedges levers, not failures.' No change to MORNING TABLE v1.1, the partner rule or any submit.
realistic_gain: 0 LB (info only; it removes a false reason to spend a finals slot on 'failure insurance'). The public CI step (~+0.001) is the most CI could lose; the private CI gain is unknown.
